market_summary: Across the board during the New York session, metals, major currencies, and BTC remain in pronounced intraday downtrends below their respective daily VWAPs, EMA50s, and Value Areas. However, following earlier selloffs, all assets are currently consolidating or hovering near session lows on sub-1.0 RVOL with waning cumulative delta momentum. Without yellow RVOL breakout spikes or clean liquidity sweep reversals, disciplined risk management dictates a uniform HOLD across all symbols.

signals.rationale: Volume Profile shows price trading below VAL (3893.78) and below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH (-8.87, slope -0.96), agreeing with the broader intraday macro downtrend but showing deceleration during this minor counter-trend pause. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is structurally below downward-sloping VWAP (3934.24) and below EMA50 (3915.74). In terms of ATR channel position, candles are consolidating mid-channel between the lower band (3865.08) and baseline EMA20 (3885.64). Volume confirmation is weak with RVOL at 0.706 (no yellow RVOL > 2.0 spike), indicating lack of breakout conviction. Price bounced from Session Low (3852.35) and is now holding just above the Gamma Flip (3874.69). GEX context is in a POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime with nearest Put Wall #1 at 3822.81 and Call Wall #1 at 4150.48; positive dealer gamma suppresses expansion and promotes mean-reversion chop. With price stuck mid-channel without confirmation, setup warrants a HOLD.

signals.level_event: rejection / holding above Gamma Flip 3874.69 after Session Low bounce

signals.rationale: Volume Profile indicates price is positioned below VAL (1.10719) and below POC (1.10942). CVD is NEUTRAL (-8,130 with slope -3801.27), diverging from the aggressive earlier price decline as selling pressure wanes near lows. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains deeply below descending VWAP (1.10791) and EMA50 (1.10762) baselines. ATR band position shows candles pressing right against the lower ATR band (1.10493). RVOL is low at 0.604, lacking the required yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout surge to justify shorting a fresh break of Session Low (1.10457) or S/R support. With no clean sweep or reversal trigger at support, the setup is unfavorable for new entries, dictating a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / price extended below falling VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Volume Profile positions price below VAL (1.32510) and well below POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH (-8,268), agreeing with the downtrend, but cvd_slope is flat (-95.53), reflecting exhausted momentum at the lows. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Structurally, price is trading below declining VWAP (1.32563) and EMA50 (1.32540). Candles are riding the lower ATR band (1.32238) just above Session Low (1.32210). Volume lacks conviction with RVOL at 0.926 and no yellow RVOL > 2.0 expansion spikes present. Without a high-volume breakdown of Session Low or a rejection wick reclaiming EMA20, initiating a position here offers poor edge, confirming a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / price trending below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Volume Profile shows price trading below VAL (50.765) and below POC (51.460). CVD is BEARISH (-289, slope -32.01), aligned with the intraday bear trend though delta velocity has decayed into a plateau. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is cleanly below downward-sloping VWAP (51.033) and EMA50 (50.642). In the ATR envelope, price is drifting mid-channel between the lower band (49.786) and baseline EMA20 (50.208). Volume confirmation is absent with RVOL printing 0.654 with no yellow RVOL > 2.0 bars. Price is stalled after rebounding from Session Low (49.688) with no clear catalyst to challenge overhead S/R (50.711). This mid-channel compression mandates a HOLD.

signals.rationale: Volume Profile places price below VAL (72037.43) and below POC (73501.60). CVD is BEARISH (-0.08) with a flat cvd_slope of 0.0, agreeing with the general drop but showing passive flow. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION.
